label: a6-retry99-lem-compact-uniform-spaces-are-complete
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Checked the empty uniform space (no proper filter exists, so vacuous completeness), finite spaces, non‑Hausdorff uniformities, and the non‑emptiness of the filter family (so the FIP condition never applies to an empty family). The proof relies only on the topological FIP equivalence and the Cauchy‑cluster lemma, neither of which requires separation. No counterexample was found.

SOURCES: The full text of the four cited items—def‑compact‑space, def‑complete‑uniform‑space, lem‑cauchy‑filter‑with‑a‑cluster‑point‑converges, and thm‑compact‑iff‑fip—was supplied and inspected. Each correctly states the fact used: compactness definitions, the FIP equivalence, the convergence of a Cauchy filter with a cluster point, and the definition of completeness.

CHECKED: Read the title “Every compact uniform space is complete”, the Statement, the Facts & Assumptions, every numbered proof step (1.1, 2.1, 3.1), and Remarks (none). The reasoning is logically valid and the citations are accurate.
